AI Engineer(Having slots 9:30AM for 2 days)
Exp :- 5+ Years
Location :- Hybrid - Gurugram, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Bhopal, Chennai
Duartion :- Long term



Role Overview

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with 5+ years of experience in AWS cloud, full-stack development, AI/ML integration, and DevOps. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building scalable cloud-native applications, integrating LLM/Generative AI capabilities, and working with modern engineering and automation practices.

Mandatory Skills

4+ years of software development experience

Strong experience with AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, CloudFormation)

Proficiency in Python, Java, or Node.js

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and ROSA (Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS)

Hands-on experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab, AWS CodePipeline)

Knowledge of DevOps and distributed systems

Experience with AWS AI Services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, AgentCore)

Experience integrating LLMs/Generative AI into applications

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro)

Understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI workflows

Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain scalable cloud-native applications on AWS.

Build AI/ML-powered features and integrate LLM-based solutions.

Design and deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and ROSA.

Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.

Ensure application security, scalability, and performance.

Mentor junior engineers and adopt modern AI-assisted development practices. General IST 2LPM Hybrid - Gurugram, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Bhopal, Chennai Long term
